samples.title: Beam bending with real units
samples.description: A simply supported beam: moment, section capacity and a utilisation check. Units are real, so a stress times a section modulus comes out in kN.m.

samples.title: Short column in compression
samples.description: Axial capacity of a short column, with several quantities on one line and a pass or fail message.

samples.title: Loads on a floor (table, vectors)
samples.description: A Markdown table of loads, load combinations in kPa, a line load per beam, and vector and matrix literals.

samples.title: Bending moment diagram (plot)
samples.description: A moment function defined with a name(x): line and plotted with a plot line.

samples.title: Bending stress with LaTeX prose
samples.description: Inline and display LaTeX in the prose and in notes, rendered with KaTeX.

samples.title: Mixing with Calcpad code and loops
samples.description: Sheet lines, a raw Calcpad loop that shares variables with them, and friendly indented for and if blocks.

samples.title: Beam deflection (sheet version, with a plot)
samples.description: The deflection and rotation of a simply supported beam under a uniform load, with the deflection curve plotted. A short sheet version of the bundled deflection example.

samples.title: Cantilever tip deflection (sheet version, with a loop)
samples.description: Tip deflection, rotation and fixed-end moment of a cantilever, and a for loop over load multiples. A short sheet version of the bundled cantilever example.

samples.title: Beam explorer with Python and Plotly
samples.file: sheet-samples/Beam explorer with Python and Plotly.sheet
samples.description: The sheet form of the beam explorer: a python fence solves a three-span beam for several load cases and draws the results with the Plotly API (make_subplots, a load case menu and two sliders, no script), and quantity lines check the envelope.

samples.title: Beam deflection derived symbolically
samples.description: The midspan deflection of a simply supported beam derived step by step with the Symbolic dialog (integrate, solve for the constants, substitute), typeset as LaTeX, then fed with numbers and checked against the derived curve.

samples.title: Laguerre polynomial roots
samples.description: Coefficients from a loop, every real root from one polyroots call, a residual check and the curve.

samples.title: Template: simply supported beam check
samples.description: Span, load, a section and a material from drop-downs, and a deflection limit from radio buttons; bending stress, deflection, both utilisations and a moment diagram follow as you change the form.

samples.title: Template: cantilever with a tip load
samples.description: A cantilever with a point load at the free end: length, load, a rectangular section, a material and a deflection limit as inputs; moment, shear, stress, tip deflection and rotation and a moment diagram.

samples.title: Template: rectangular column slenderness
samples.description: Slenderness and buckling of a solid rectangular column: size, length, end conditions and material as inputs; the slenderness class, the Euler or parabolic critical stress and the allowed load.

samples.title: Template: pad footing bearing pressure
samples.description: A pad footing under a column load and moment: sizes, depth and a soil from a drop-down; eccentricity, the largest and smallest bearing pressure, uplift and the check against the allowable pressure.

samples.title: Template: pipe flow, Darcy-Weisbach
samples.description: Friction loss in a full pipe: flow rate, diameter, length, pipe material and water temperature as inputs; velocity, Reynolds number, friction factor, head loss, pump head and hydraulic power.

samples.title: Template: retaining wall sliding and overturning
samples.description: A cantilever retaining wall on level fill: dimensions, a backfill from radio buttons and a surcharge checkbox as inputs; earth thrust, factors of safety against overturning and sliding, and the bearing pressure under the base.

samples.title: Template: pump and pipeline operating point
samples.description: A pump lifting water through a pipeline: pump size from radio buttons, pipe diameter from a drop-down, length, lift and an aged-pipe checkbox as inputs; the operating point, a table of flow against pump and pipeline head, and both curves plotted.

samples.title: 3D plate deflection surface
samples.description: A simply supported slab panel by the Navier series, drawn as a rotatable 3D surface with projected contours. The centre deflection is checked against span/250.

samples.title: 3D biaxial column interaction
samples.description: A column's N-Mx-My interaction surface (Bresler load contour) with the design action as a marker, and an inside or outside check.

samples.title: 3D space frame geometry
samples.description: A two-bay, three-storey space frame as 3D lines, each member coloured by utilisation, with hover labels.

samples.title: 3D mode shapes explorer
samples.description: The first nine modes of a simply supported plate on a 3D surface, with a dropdown to switch mode and the frequencies computed.

samples.title: 3D footing reactions bar chart
samples.description: Column reactions on a footing grid as 3D bars (one Mesh3d trace), coloured by load, with a pad area check.

samples.title: Plot gallery: implicit curves, functions, polylines
samples.description: Four plots on a grid in the style of a plotting demo: implicit curves f(x, y) = 0, functions, parametric and noisy curves, polylines with markers, a legend and a second y axis.

samples.title: Animated beam, moving load
samples.description: A point load travels along a simply supported beam: Play, Pause and a slider step through precomputed Plotly frames.

samples.title: Design check as a flow diagram
samples.description: A Mermaid flow diagram of a beam check next to the calculation that follows the same steps.

samples.title: Load path and tributary loads
samples.description: A Mermaid diagram of the load path from slab to soil, with the loads worked out at each level.

samples.title: Design states of a steel beam (state diagram)
samples.description: A state diagram of the checks a beam passes before it is issued, next to the bending, shear and deflection checks that decide the state it reaches.

samples.title: Review and sign-off (sequence diagram)
samples.description: A sequence diagram of a calculation passing between designer, checker and project engineer, with the review time worked out.

samples.title: Construction programme (Gantt chart)
samples.description: Durations of a ground slab worked out from quantities and production rates, shown as a Gantt chart.

samples.title: Dead load share (pie chart)
samples.description: The layers of a floor worked out as loads and drawn as a pie chart, with the share of each as a percentage.

samples.title: Cost plan (treemap)
samples.description: A treemap of a building cost plan in groups, with the group totals and shares worked out.

samples.title: Site risk matrix (quadrant chart)
samples.description: Likelihood and consequence scores, their ratings, and a quadrant chart that places each risk.

samples.title: Bending moment along a beam (XY chart)
samples.description: Moment and shear worked out at sixths of a span in a loop, drawn as an XY chart and as a plot of the sheet.

samples.title: Energy flow through a pump (Sankey)
samples.description: Hydraulic power traced back through the pump and the motor to the electrical input, drawn as a Sankey diagram.

samples.title: Footbridge design brief (mind map)
samples.description: A mind map of a footbridge brief, with the design line load, moment and deflection limit worked out.

samples.title: Requirements traceability (requirement diagram)
samples.description: A requirement diagram that ties strength and deflection requirements to the checks that satisfy them.

samples.title: Concrete strength gain (timeline)
samples.description: Strength of concrete at ages from 1 to 28 days from a strength gain formula, listed on a timeline and plotted.

samples.title: Section shapes (class diagram)
samples.description: A class diagram of section shapes, with the area and second moment of area of a rectangle, a circle and a tube.

samples.title: Tennis ball flight: drag, spin and trajectory
samples.description: Weight, air drag and the Magnus force from spin on a tennis ball, integrated in a python fence: groundstrokes with different spins landing on the same spot, a map of net clearance against speed and topspin, and flat, slice and kick serves in plan, side and 3D views.

samples.title: Principal stresses
samples.description: Principal stresses and directions of a plane and a 3D stress tensor from eigenvals and eigenvecs, checked with Mohr's circle.

samples.title: Shear frame natural frequencies
samples.description: Natural frequencies and mode shapes of a two storey shear frame from the generalized eigenvalue problem K φ = ω² M φ, eigenvals(K, M).

samples.title: Principal axes of a section
samples.description: Strong and weak axes of an unsymmetric section from eigenvals and eigenvecs, checked against the closed form.

samples.title: Gable frame thrust: pinned or rigid ridge
samples.description: Horizontal thrust of a symmetric pitched roof frame for a pinned ridge and a rigid ridge, with the common shortcut that overstates it.
